name: qfd_crom_g_m5-q13a-COMMIT
purpose: slot-shaped M5 re-design of qfd_crom_g (closed qfd_crom_g_a-ff3637ce7-tc: TT +2.59, signals to M7, pins S/W): all pins + clock on the N face on M5, macros in one column with W 43.2 / E 29.4 um pin channels, halo 2.16 -> 5.4 um, macro pin-edge M5 guard; RTL relay stages (RLY 1, strobe->q 5 -> 8 edges): column address register after the macro-column select, one {ce,addr} register per macro beside its pins, lane select register before the output station at the pins, so no stage carries logic plus the 518-um column wire; lane-base STRAP pin crom_lb (crom_gs) so ONE hardened master serves the 8 groups (LB 0 of ot_qfd_crom_g faults in groups 1-7)

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_crom_g_m5/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_crom_g_m5/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_crom_g_m5 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qfd_crom_gr --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_rom_4096x266_m8 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
